episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: The brand new boss Seo Jin opens a Korean snack bar in Mexico with the slogan "Profit comes first!" The staff who can't get used to his passion, Yu Mi, Seo Jun, Woo Shik, and Tae Hyung, are more than ready to make this work, but it seems impossible. Even the rain comes to bless their grand opening. "The old Seo Jin is gone. He's a boss now!" Meet them in Bacalar, a beautiful town by the lake.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As soon as Jinny's Kitchen opens, it becomes one of the most popular restaurants in Bacalar. On Day 2, new menus are added to boost sales, and it works! Customers rush in, sales go up, and the boss beams. But then Yu Mi starts making mistakes and things start to get out of control. Intern Choi comes to the rescue, to the sink full of dishes! What's happening to the reunited Jinny's Kitchen?

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As Day 3 of Jinny's Kitchen begins, the queueing begins! Their cheat code for the busy weekend is spicy fricken and hellamyeon! Will they be big hits too? The penny-pinching boss changes and even rejects customers for a break? And Seo Jun cooks for the hungry staff! After a sweet break, the customer rush starts again and they start running out of food. How will their dinner service go?

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Jinny's Kitchen got heated up with Brazil Worldcup! And now, finally, staffs have a sweet leisure time at Lake Bacalar. Starting the 4th day of business, Pineapple juice comes to the new menu board.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: After a full day off, Jinny's Kitchen faces a crisis. Seo Jun introduces a new menu, chibap, to boost sales and captivate customers. Will this ace up his sleeve bring more customers? On Wednesdays, when almost everything is closed, they'll either A) be the only restaurant open and attract all potential customers, or B) have zero customers! Will they hit the jackpot or make no money at all?

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Jinny's Kitchen is becoming famous in town! As soon as they open, they have a full house+revisiting customers+regular customers. Will their second K-Spicy menu satisfy the spicy lovers' palate? Tae Hyung in the kitchen VS Woo Shik in the service. The interns' promotion competition begins. Being in charge of three menus now, Tae Hyung dreams of becoming a sous-chef. Will their dreams come true?

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: The harder the work, the sweeter the sales! 10,000 pesos will be a cakewalk! The staff lose their appetite and ingredients run low, but customers keep coming! After a tough day, the staff go on a hunger strike and get Jinny's 3rd welfare benefit: A fun, reinvigorating jet ski break! On Day 7, tteokbokki is OUT and rice is IN. A big group shows up 2 hours before opening! Can they handle the rush?

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: After a half-day off, the staff are fully charged! With their perfect teamwork, nothing can seem to go wrong now. Then 3 tables are booked before opening! Big groups, revisitors, to-go orders, and even a rival restaurant owner? Welcome back to chaos! A spicy competition begins in Bacalar! After a never-ending customer rush, Day 7 finally ends. Will today's sales put a smile on Seo Jin's face?

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: On Day 8, Jinny's Kitchen gears up for their biggest prep yet with one goal: 12,000 pesos! Will Intern Kim impress Chef Park with a delicious corn dog and earn the title of sous-chef? The final day's customers will enjoy the exciting yet so challenging dalgona game! Everyone has a good time, until a trust issue arises. Someone touched Seo Jin's cash drawer! What's the truth behind this?

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: The 8-day journey is near its end. Will Jinny's Kitchen end on a high note? The dinner service begins full of hope but multiple orders confuse the perfect duo, Seo Jin and Woo Shik! Mastering all the back kitchen's menus, Tae Hyung starts to dance! Who awakened the natural dancer? And what's the friendly Intern Choi's promo secret? They can't go home until they hit 12,000! How will this end?

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: It's not over until it's over! The final story of the reunion and behind-the-scenes episodes! Jinny's Kitchen reunites after 4 months for a meal and a Q and A session! What happened to Yu Mi and Tae Hyung that night? The truth behind the story of betrayal reveals as well as the final sales reports and TOP 5 menus! Then the best game they've ever played quiets them down. What happened?

episodes.title: The Birth of Jinny's Ttukbaegi
episodes.summary: The second branch of Jinny's Kitchen, Jinny's Ttukbaegi, finally opens in Iceland. A talented intern with extensive experience, Min-si, joins the kitchen. But she faces an unexpected interview with the staff. Will she get a pass from them? The kitchen's new system, "Chef's Responsibility," is put into action. Who will Mr. Lee choose as today's chef?

episodes.title: The Debut of Rookie Chef
episodes.summary: Iceland's newly open Korean restaurant, Jinny's Ttukbaegi, finally starts its business! However, the restaurant faces a new level of crisis from the start. Rookie Chef Woo-shik and Intern Min-si perform as a fantastic kitchen duo through ups and downs. Lunch hours' ingredients run out, and tables are full for dinner. The first day of the debuting Chef Woo-shik unrolls in this episode!

episodes.title: The Return of Master Chef
episodes.summary: Super efficient and super organized! Chef Yu-mi, with eight years of cooking experience, returns to the kitchen. What's the secret behind her amazing speed? The moment Mr. Lee says "Today isn't so busy", customers rush in. In the end, Mr. Lee makes a big mistake. He misses getting a payment from a customer.

episodes.title: Captain Ace, Chef Seo-jun, Joins the Kitchen
episodes.summary: Chef Yu-mi's successful day ends as Korean food and soju combo mesmerizes the customers on the second day of business. Mr. Lee puts Chef Seo-jun in charge on the weekend to prepare for customers rushing in. Seo-jun is the perfect captain who can lead 6 stove pits at a time. Seo-jun, the ace of the kitchen, starts cooking.

episodes.title: There Comes An Aurora After Hard Work
episodes.summary: Seo-jun's kitchen goes smoothly without a flaw. However, there comes an unexpected confusion. What's behind the serving full of misunderstanding? Customers are surprised first at the looks of food, and second at its sweet and sour flavor! Chef Park finally reveals his first-ever new menu item at Jinny's. There comes a gift after a long day. A day that is more like a movie than a movie unfolds!

episodes.title: Ace Chef Park's Reboot
episodes.summary: Chef Park is not worried regardless of the nonstop customer-rush. As the Captain of the Kitchen returns with spicy "Sundubu-jjigae", the restaurant is back to business. The best service comes from the best ambience. What is Mr. Lee's strategy to bring back the peace at "Jinny's Ttukbaegi?"

episodes.title: It's The Invitation Day!
episodes.summary: Woo-shik's birthday is here with heavy snow. However, the staff is only into working. Singing "Happy Birthday To Me" by himself, Mr. Choi encounters a touching plot twist. It's the 5th business day. They are inviting Iceland's warm neighbors who helped them open the restaurant. They are ready to open the restaurant for "Invitation Day" with Chef Yu-mi's new menu filled with love.

episodes.title: Chef Choi's Secret Menu, Ttukbaegi Bulgogi
episodes.summary: Part 2 of the Invitation Day begins. From the local translators to the expert in charge of setting electrical lines at the restaurant! Will Jinny's Ttukbaegi be able to run the restaurant smoothly for those who helped? Chef Choi is back! He's back with the best new menu ever, ttukbaegi bulgogi. The meat won't get cooked when the orders get piled up. Will Chef Woo-shik make it as a chef again?

episodes.title: The Late-Night Overtime Chaos
episodes.summary: Chef Woo-shik is a whole new person now! He stays calm and charismatic even at multiple orders at a time. On top of that, he's also witty in the kitchen. Woo-shik's big role as a chef unfolds. As the 6th business day is over, the lights are still on at Jinny's Ttukbaegi late at night. All you can hear in the kitchen is chopping sounds. Prepare for the midnight mega-meal-prep nightmare!

episodes.title: We Are Open All Day Today
episodes.summary: Finally, it's the last day at Jinny's Ttukbaegi. When will they get off work? No idea. Will they have a break? No. To sell out all of their menus today, they are open all day. "Mr. Dishwasher, please help!" Headquarters take special measures for the staff as there are nonstop orders and dishes to wash. Who's the new part-timer that made Intern Ko flustered?

episodes.title: Goodbye, Iceland!
episodes.summary: It's the last day of Jinny Kitchen. Intern Ko is doing her best until the final moment. Then she cries secretly. What's the story behind the tears on the last day? Wait a minute--they can't just end it like that. From the behind-the-scenes in Iceland to Jinny's Ttukbaegi goods with memories, they go on with recreational time as well. The eventful closing ceremony is coming soon!
